titles.title: Less Bureaucracy, Better Family Engagement Act
Less Bureaucracy, Better Family Engagement Act
To ensure the Department of Health and Human Services will manage family engagement programs for elementary and secondary education, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.
